test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to improve it, select ‘No improvement required’.

This mango tree yields __lot of__ mangoes every year.
solution:
The correct answer is **'a lot of'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• First of all, let's remove the confusion between '**a lot of', 'lots of', and 'a lot'.**

 
 
• **'A lot of' and 'lots of', **both of them have the **same meaning that is a large amount or number of people or things.**
 
• ***Both of them are used before countable or uncountable nouns.***
 
• **'A lot' **means **very often or very much.**
 
• ***It's used as an adverb and often comes at the end of the sentence.***
 
 
 
• On the basis of the above-given information, it's clarified that **'lot of' and 'the lot of' are wrong options.**
 
• The third option **'a lot' is not suitable** here.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's **understand the concept** with **some examples.**

 
• **Lots of** vehicles pass down this street.
 
• We have **a lot of** time to get it done.
 
• I don't like sweets **a lot**.
